svg.title: Condition preferences have an owner, set by the reaction
svg.desc: Field-level molecular experience and the untested owner question lead to reciprocal partner replacements, molecular versus pair-specific decomposition, and the discoveries of median 80% molecular ownership, reaction-dependent roles, halide ownership and approximately threefold condition-profile prediction. Small real recurring molecules illustrate identity connections only. Schematic well counts encode no measurements.
